turns.prompt:
Consolidate exports/shard-*.csv into active.csv. For each record_id, select the row with the greatest numeric revision across all shards; each (record_id,revision) is unique. Only after selecting that latest row, drop it if its state is deleted. For each remaining record, use the customer and amount_cents from that selected row. Write active.csv with header record_id,customer,amount_cents and ASCII record_id order. Include all active records at this stage, regardless of customer enablement; do not add a total row.
Work in /app. Process the inputs in bulk and actually create the requested files. Keep every original input file unchanged. Bash, python3 and basic system commands are available; no network or package installation is needed.
Also state the sum of amount_cents in active.csv before customer filtering in your reply, using decimal digits.

Use the active.csv you just generated and customers.csv to create summary.csv. Every active customer ID has exactly one mapping. Keep only records whose customer has enabled=yes, then group them by region. Output header region,records,total_cents, followed by the record count and integer sum of amount_cents for every represented region, in ASCII region order. Keep active.csv unchanged.

turns.final: Created the requested report files. The active records total 15225 cents before customer filtering.
